messages:
Samir (PM): kicking off change window for prod rollout v2.3.1 — start traffic shift at :15. release notes: https://redwood-internal/release/v2.3.1

deploy-bot: [deploy] starting canary -> 10% traffic to v2.3.1 in us-east, eu-west, ap-south

Maria (oncall): seeing p95 embed-service jump in eu-west, from 120ms -> 420ms over last 2 mins, dashboard: https://grafana/r/abcd

Alex D. (eng): noted. any 5xx spikes? can you paste the quick tail from the embed logs?

Maria (oncall): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-21T12:31:02Z embed-service eu-west 502 upstream_timeout id=xyz
2026-03-21T12:31:04Z embed-service eu-west 502 upstream_timeout id=abc
2026-03-21T12:31:05Z embed-service eu-west 503 internal_error id=def
```

Priya (sre): also seeing increased client-side timeouts in eu-west (error rate 0.9% -> 2.6%). p50/ p95 drift is region-local. No other regions hit.

Alex D. (eng): proposal — pause/eject eu-west from v2.3.1 and pin eu-west to v2.3.0. roll forward elsewhere. Priya, ok with that for safety?

Priya (sre): agree. set guard: if 5xx >1.5% for 3 consecutive mins in any region, auto-rollback. Manual for eu-west.

Kai (release): doing the pin now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] executing region pin: service=embed-service region=eu-west target_version=v2.3.0
deploy-bot: [deploy] traffic shift paused in eu-west; confirmed pinned to v2.3.0

Samir (PM): thanks — leaving notes in release doc and tagging customers on the EU edge. action items: eng to triage root cause in eu-west, ops to monitor SLOs for 10m.

Alex D. (eng): starting triage, will post findings. hitting the smoke tests locally and running canary logs.

Maria (oncall): will keep an eye on dashboards. ping me if anything else spikes. :thumbsup:

Kai (release): updated release notes with regional pin and mitigation steps.

Samir (PM): ok, rolling remainder of rollout to 100% in other regions, keeping eu-west pinned. deploy-bot, continue.

deploy-bot: [deploy] resuming rollout: us-east/ap-south -> v2.3.1; eu-west remains pinned

Priya (sre): monitoring thresholds rearmed; will escalate to oncall if any cross-region issues.

Alex D. (eng): quick note — suspect timeout config change in v2.3.1 embed client. investigating. will open a patch if confirmed.

Samir (PM): great. keep updates here. end.
